subject: Improve XXH_mult64to128 performance on MSVC ARM64
perf_evidence: Improve XXH_mult64to128 performance on MSVC ARM64
change_summary: Improve XXH_mult64to128 performance on MSVC ARM64

units.name: MSVC ARM64 XXH_mult64to128
units.evidence: Clang targeting aarch64-pc-windows-msvc19.33.0 produces differing old/new target IR; Alive2 forward and backward both report timeout for arbitrary 64-bit multiplicands.

notes: The actual MSVC ARM64 multiply helper is compiled to LLVM IR, but both Alive2 directions time out on the changed raw arithmetic; fixed public XXH3 targets were generated but are not proved.
